![用此描述替换](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac182bc3589fc1d09ffb1f8ebfdb77707b8e4332.png)
[![Discord 服务器](https://img.shields.io/discord/1446530427337576541?style=for-the-badge&logo=Discord&logoColor=white&label=Discord&color=728ADA)](https://discord.gg/2P8kfceSmt) [![CurseForge 下载量](https://img.shields.io/curseforge/dt/1483746?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white&label=curseforge&color=F16436)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/refined-torches) [![Modrinth 下载量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/M6aa729D?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&label=Modrinth&color=1CD96A)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/refined-torches)
![描述](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/899c0e364c509449cd21d46c78cd5a7775ff9951.png) 本资源包为火把、灯笼和营火赋予了精致的3D外观，在保持原版风格的基础上增加了更多层次感和细节。物品栏图标默认保持2D，因此能很好地与其他修改精灵图的资源包兼容。 ![tocha2](https://i.imgur.com/TFnVDbO.gif) 它还包含微妙的动画效果，若你使用 [InteractiveStuff](https://modrinth.com/mod/interactivestuff)、[HMI](https://modrinth.com/mod/hold-my-items) 或 [Punchy!](https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa) 模组，手持时还会获得额外的动态效果。同时兼容 [Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension) 或 [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations)（若你喜欢更原版的体验！）——你需使用 [Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts) 开启兼容选项。 ![teste](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/M6aa729D/images/13aaa161352e8f7ce8389e55947e1dcdf3a9ac68.webp)
![重要](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c6570fc1c8af37836ab6d9863e9b10a47862ff43.png)
推荐模组
1.21.5及以下版本必需的模组
![额外](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8d7617a2089b78091525c99f005816d975744d69_0.webp)
致谢
本资源包整合了以下项目的资源：
* **[Fresh Animations: Player Extension](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fa-player-extension)** * **[Fire Rekindled](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fire-rekindled)**

> **注意：** 所有功劳归原作者所有。这些资源的使用已获得作者的明确许可。
